description: Accessible dropdown: an APG menu button for actions, or (with hover) an APG disclosure for navigation links

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Menu position relative to the trigger. start/end are logical, so they mirror in RTL

attributes.name: hover
attributes.description: Navigation disclosure: no menu roles, links stay in the Tab order, a <button aria-expanded> toggles the list (generated next to a link trigger). Opens on mouse hover or toggle activation, not on focus

attributes.name: no-flip
attributes.description: Keep the requested position instead of flipping to the opposite side when the menu overflows the viewport

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected state — set by open()/close()/toggle() methods, not intended as initial markup

structure.description: Trigger element that opens the menu. Action mode: aria-haspopup="menu" + aria-expanded. Navigation mode: a link trigger stays a plain link
Navigation mode with a link trigger: the submenu toggle (aria-expanded, aria-controls). Generated with aria-label "<link text> submenu" when absent; author one to set your own label
Menu container with <li> items holding <button> or <a> actions. Only rows whose nearest menu is this one belong to it (nested drop-downs keep their own)

childAttributes.name: data-trigger
childAttributes.description: Marks the element that opens the menu. Falls back to the first direct <button> if absent.

childAttributes.name: data-disabled
childAttributes.description: Disabled item: aria-disabled="true", stays in the arrow-key order, cannot be activated

childAttributes.name: data-value
childAttributes.description: Value reported in drop-down:select detail.value and the items property

events.name: drop-down:select
events.description: Fired when one of this menu's items is activated by click or keyboard (not for disabled items or a nested drop-down's trigger row)

events.name: drop-down:items-changed
events.description: Fired after the items property rebuilds the menu

properties.name: items
properties.type: Array<{ label, value?, href?, disabled? } | { separator: true }>
properties.description: Get the menu as data, or assign to rebuild it (href → <a>, otherwise <button type="button">; disabled → data-disabled + aria-disabled)

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only. Whether the menu is open
